name: Tablić
description: Tablić (or Tablanette) is a fishing-style card game popular in the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia). Players capture face-up cards from the table by matching their value or summing to their value. Points are awarded for capturing specific high-value cards (face cards, 10s, Aces) and for having the most cards. The game is similar to Casino.

content.text: Tablić (or Tablanette) is a fishing-style card game popular in the Balkans (Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia). Players capture face-up cards from the table by matching their value or summing to their value. Points are awarded for capturing specific high-value cards (face cards, 10s, Aces) and for having the most cards. The game is similar to Casino.
Derived from the Casino family of fishing games; widely played in the former Yugoslavia.
Normally two players, or four in fixed partnerships with partners sitting opposite. A three-player game is also possible but less usual; in Serbia deal and play are counter-clockwise.
Dealer deals 6 cards to each player and 4 face up on the table. Only the first deal places cards on the table. Subsequent deals refill hands until the deck is exhausted.
